capabilities: Query REST, GraphQL, JSON-RPC, and gRPC-proxy endpoints from data-query code blocks
Render responses as JSON, tables, or Markdown templates
Write selected response values into note frontmatter
Cache responses and browse, filter, and delete cached entries
Import and export endpoint aliases between devices
extras: README includes a privacy and data disclosure section: it sends configured URLs, headers, and bodies to the endpoints you define and stores cached responses in a .data-fetcher-cache folder in the vault root. Endpoint header exports are excluded by default to avoid leaking API tokens.
problem: Obsidian notes are static files with no built-in way to pull live data from external APIs into a note.

requires.name: credentials for authenticated APIs via custom headers

summary: Data fetcher that queries REST, GraphQL, JSON-RPC, and gRPC-proxy endpoints from data-query code blocks and renders results in notes.
